commands.name: init
commands.help: Initialize paper trading database.

commands.name: list-accounts
commands.help: List all paper trading accounts.

commands.name: create-account
commands.help: Create a new paper account.

arguments.help: Display name shown in operator summaries and reports
Goal time period label, e.g. weekly, monthly, quarterly
Enable heuristic exploration mode for this account
Target portfolio allocation percent for each new buy
Maximum portfolio allocation percent allowed for a single position
Execution style: equity shares or LEAPs-style simulation
Option strike offset percent vs underlying (for LEAPs simulation)
Preferred option type for options-style trading
Max option premium budget per trade
Benchmark ticker for this strategy account (default: SPY)

commands.name: set-benchmark
commands.help: Set benchmark ticker for an account.

commands.name: assign-strategy
commands.help: Assign an existing, enabled catalog strategy to a book (unknown keys are rejected).

arguments.help: Book name (default: the account's default book)

commands.name: configure-account
commands.help: Update per-account metadata and goals.

arguments.help: Display name shown in operator summaries and reports
Goal time period label, e.g. weekly, monthly, quarterly
Turn on heuristic exploration mode for this account
Turn off heuristic exploration mode for this account
Target portfolio allocation percent for each new buy
Maximum portfolio allocation percent allowed for a single position
Execution style: equity shares or LEAPs-style simulation
Option strike offset percent vs underlying (for LEAPs simulation)
Preferred option type for options-style trading
Max option premium budget per trade

commands.name: trade
commands.help: Record a mock buy or sell.

commands.name: report
commands.help: Show account status and open positions.

commands.name: promotion-status
commands.help: Show read-only promotion readiness based on the canonical evaluation artifact.

commands.name: promotion-request-review
commands.help: Persist the current promotion assessment as a manual review request.

commands.name: promotion-review-history
commands.help: Show persisted promotion review requests and audit events.

commands.name: promotion-review-action
commands.help: Approve, reject, or annotate an open promotion review request.

commands.name: snapshot
commands.help: Save equity snapshot for an account.

commands.name: snapshot-history
commands.help: Show account snapshot history.

commands.name: portfolio-exposure
commands.help: Show the cross-account exposure rollup (equity, cash, market value) from each account's latest snapshot.

commands.name: parameters
commands.help: Show the unified parameter source: global settings, per-book settings, and strategy knobs with their effective values and sources.

arguments.help: Optional account filter for book settings

commands.name: portfolio-concentration
commands.help: Show cross-account concentration by symbol (share of total market value, overlap across accounts) with a sector rollup.

commands.name: compare-strategies
commands.help: Compare current paper accounts by account policy state, holdings, benchmark, and trend (not canonical research scores).

arguments.help: Snapshot lookback count for trend classification (default: 10)

commands.name: configure-throttle
commands.help: Edit the global trade throttle (omitted flags keep their current values; pass 'none' to clear).

arguments.help: Max trades per day, or 'none' for unlimited
Max trades per minute, or 'none' for unlimited

commands.name: configure-evaluation
commands.help: Edit global evaluation confidence settings (omitted flags keep their current values).

commands.name: configure-book-rotation-policy
commands.help: Edit a book's rotation policy (weights, threshold, cooldown, min-trades). Omitted flags keep their current values; pass 'none' to fall back to the code default.

arguments.help: Book name (default: the account's default book)

commands.name: configure-book-rotation
commands.help: Edit a book's rotation scheduling (enabled gate, challenger schedule, lookback). Omitted flags keep their current values; pass 'none' to clear schedule/lookback.

arguments.help: Book name (default: the account's default book)
Comma-separated challenger strategy names, or 'none' for incumbent-only
Evidence lookback window in days, or 'none' for the code default

commands.name: configure-promotion
commands.help: Edit global promotion policy settings (omitted flags keep their current values).

commands.name: settings-history
commands.help: Show the global settings change-audit history (throttle, evaluation, promotion edits).

arguments.help: Number of change events to show

commands.name: book-rotation-history
commands.help: Show a book's rotation settings change-audit history (scheduling and policy edits).

arguments.help: Book name (default: the account's default book)
Number of change events to show

commands.name: create-strategy-variant
commands.help: Create a new draft strategy variant of a code primitive with tuned knobs.

commands.name: configure-strategy
commands.help: Edit a draft strategy's knobs and/or enabled flag (untouched knobs are kept).

commands.name: freeze-strategy
commands.help: Freeze a draft strategy (one-way; tuning it afterward requires a new variant).

commands.name: backtest
commands.help: Run a historical backtest for an existing account configuration.

arguments.help: Optional folder of monthly universe snapshots named YYYY-MM.txt
Alternative to --start: look back N months from end date
Slippage in basis points per trade
Allow approximate LEAPs backtest mode using underlying price proxies
Optional strategy override (default: the account's active strategy)

commands.name: backtest-report
commands.help: Show summary metrics for a previous backtest run tied to an account configuration.

commands.name: backtest-leaderboard
commands.help: Rank historical account backtest runs by total return.

arguments.help: Maximum number of runs to return (default: 10)
Optional case-insensitive account strategy label filter

commands.name: backtest-batch
commands.help: Run backtests for multiple accounts with shared date and universe settings.

arguments.help: Optional folder of monthly universe snapshots named YYYY-MM.txt
Alternative to --start: look back N months from end date
Slippage in basis points per trade
Allow approximate LEAPs backtest mode using underlying price proxies
Optional prefix for generated run names

commands.name: backtest-optimize
commands.help: Walk-forward parameter optimization for one strategy: grid-search on each training window, freeze the winner, then report out-of-sample and holdout evidence against the strategy's current catalog parameters.

arguments.help: Strategy to optimize (catalog key or alias)
JSON object of parameter -> candidate values, e.g. '{"fast_window": [5, 10, 15], "slow_window": [20, 30]}'. Keys must be parameters of the strategy.
Optional folder of monthly universe snapshots named YYYY-MM.txt
Alternative to --start: look back N months from end date
Slippage in basis points per trade
Allow approximate LEAPs backtest mode using underlying price proxies
Out-of-sample test window length in months
Months to roll forward between windows
Untouched final holdout length in months (0 to disable)
Maximum grid size; a larger Cartesian product is rejected, not truncated
Indicator warm-up history loaded before each window (default: 6); raise for large window params

commands.name: backtest-optimize-show
commands.help: Show a persisted optimization experiment: config, winner params, OOS/holdout evidence, promotion status.

commands.name: backtest-optimize-promote
commands.help: Promote an optimization experiment's winner into a new tradeable strategy variant (frozen by default) and link it back to the experiment.

arguments.help: Strategy key for the new variant
Leave the new variant as an editable draft instead of freezing it (default: freeze)
Bypass the promotion quality bar (winner must beat its baseline on OOS and holdout evidence) and promote anyway

commands.name: backtest-bench
commands.help: Run strategies through synthetic and real-history scenarios and compare their outcome distributions. Behavioral only — bench runs are not persisted and are not promotion evidence.

arguments.help: Comma-separated strategies to run (default: all registered strategies)
Comma-separated scenario ids or aliases (default: all synthetic scenarios; real-history scenarios need a captured fixture and run only by name)
Paths per Monte Carlo scenario (default: each scenario's own count, 200); single-path replay scenarios always run once
Metric rendered in the matrix (default: total_return_pct)
Slippage in basis points per trade
List the available scenarios and exit

commands.name: advisor-record
commands.help: Record an advisor decision (including hold) with its rationale and frozen evidence.

arguments.help: Book name (default: the account's default book)
Who made the decision (default: operator; the advisor agent passes 'agent')
Catalog strategy the decision puts or keeps in place (default: the book's assigned strategy)
Catalog strategy the decision rejected; scoring backtests both over the following window. Omit for disable_strategy and run_experiment.
Extra evidence to freeze with the decision; repeatable
Trading days before the outcome is scored (default: 21)

commands.name: advisor-digest
commands.help: Show each account's evaluation, recent decisions, and review flags. Read-only.

arguments.help: Limit to one account (default: all accounts)
Trading date YYYY-MM-DD that decides which decisions are due (default: today, UTC)

commands.name: advisor-score
commands.help: Score decisions whose outcome window has closed: backtest the chosen and rejected strategies over the window that followed and record the verdict.

arguments.help: Limit to one account (default: all accounts)
Trading date YYYY-MM-DD that decides which decisions are due (default: today, UTC)

commands.name: advisor-scorecard
commands.help: Show the track record of scored decisions: points, mean edge with an interval, and points by market regime. Read-only.

arguments.help: Limit to one account (default: all accounts)
